preset.title: Tutorial Mode
targets: Teams can write their own captions

params.name: format
params.value: ($1), do you want to use the standard caption list?

preset.header: Are you ready for the tutorial?
preset.text: Once enough people click Ready, the tutorial will start!

preset.header: Each team is given their own caption
preset.text:
As a team, you must draw that caption on a shared whiteboard before your timer runs out.

The captions tend to be on the wacky side! For example, the caption for this drawing was every action movie.

preset.header: One drawing is revealed at a time
preset.text: Every team (besides the team whose drawing is being shown) submits their own caption for the drawing.

preset.header: All the fake captions are revealed anonymously
preset.text: Among these captions is also the original real caption for the drawing. After seeing all the captions, each player must individually click on the caption that THEY think is the real one.

You get 20 points if you correctly click on the real caption for the drawing.
You get 10 points per player for each player who voted for your team's fake caption!

You can see your score in the bottom-right of your video box.

preset.header: When your team's drawing is being shown...
preset.text: ... then during the voting phase, vote for your favorite incorrect caption. The team that submitted this caption will get a "like" (❤️) from you.

preset.header: Are you ready to start the game?
preset.text: Once enough people click Ready, the real game will start!
